description:
List the audio files this R3 account owns, with the URL to use for each one. That URL is exactly what R3ComponentAudio.url takes, so this is how you find a sound the account already has — a footstep, a drum hit, a music bed — and then point an Audio component at it with r3_component_set.

Search by name rather than paging: search: "kick" is matched against every audio file on the account by the server, not against the page you happen to be holding.

You cannot upload an audio file from here — a tool argument is JSON, this server cannot read your disk, and audio is megabytes. A person uploads those in the R3 app. r3_sound_create makes a new sound effect or seamless loop from a recipe (rendered by R3, listed here afterwards); R3's music components (Transport, Beat, Pattern, DrumGrid) synthesise music that stays editable and in tempo.
